title: juncago maritima
intro: Juncago maritima, commonly known as Seablite, is a succulent plant belonging to the family Amaranthaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing, likely due to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Juncago maritima include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
